title: TesseraQL field domains v1
description: Schema for TesseraQL field domain documents (domains/*.yml): named field knowledge referenced from input fields with 'domain:', plus the app-level constraint catalog. Documented in field-domains.md.
$comment: The domain map's value is an input field, referenced from the shared definitions rather than copied here - the copy this file used to carry needed a test to keep it honest.

domains.description: Named field domains. A route's input field references one with 'domain: <name>' and may override any individual key locally.

constraints.description: Database constraint names mapped once for the whole app, so a violation of a shared unique index reports the same field, code and message on every route that can raise it.

field.description: The input field the violation is reported against.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code for the violation.

message.description: Message key resolved through the app's i18n bundles.
